L172: # DataView.prototype.setInt32()
L173: 
L174: Baseline
L175: 
L176: Widely available
L177: 
L178: This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions. It’s been available across browsers since July 2015.
L179: 
L180:   * 【86†See full compatibility】
L181:   * 【87†Learn more】
L182: The `setInt32()` method of 【88†`DataView`】 instances takes a number and stores it as a 32-bit signed integer in the 4 bytes starting at the specified byte offset of this `DataView`. There is no alignment constraint; multi-byte values may be stored at any offset within bounds.
L183: ## In this article
L184: 
L185:   * 【89†Try it】
L186:   * 【90†Syntax】
L187:   * 【91†Examples】
L188:   * 【92†Specifications】
L189:   * 【86†Browser compatibility】
L190:   * 【93†See also】
L191: 
L192: ## 【89†Try it】
L193: 
L194:     `// Create an ArrayBuffer with a size in bytes
L195:     const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(16);
L196: 
L197:     const view = new DataView(buffer);
L198:     view.setInt32(1, 2147483647); // Max signed 32-bit integer
L199: 
L200:     console.log(view.getInt32(1));
L201:     // Expected output: 2147483647
L202:     `
L203: ## 【90†Syntax】
L204: 
L205: js
L206: 
L207:     `setInt32(byteOffset, value)
L208:     setInt32(byteOffset, value, littleEndian)
L209:     `
L210: ### 【94†Parameters】
L211: 
L212: 【95†`byteOffset`】
L213: 
L214: 
L215: The offset, in bytes, from the start of the view to store the data in.
L216: 
L217: 【96†`value`】
L218: 
L219: 
L220: The value to set. For how the value is encoded in bytes, see 【97†Value encoding and normalization】.
L221: 
L222: 【98†`littleEndian` Optional】
L223: 
L224: 
L225: Indicates whether the data is stored in 【99†little- or big-endian】 format. If `false` or `undefined`, a big-endian value is written.
L226: 
L227: ### 【100†Return value】
L228: 
L229: 【101†`undefined`】.
L230: ### 【102†Exceptions】
L231: 
L232: 【103†`RangeError`】
L233: 
L234: 
L235: Thrown if the `byteOffset` is set such that it would store beyond the end of the view.
L236: 
L237: ## 【91†Examples】
L238: 
L239: ### 【104†Using setInt32()】
L240: 
L241: js
L242: 
L243:     `const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(10);
L244:     const dataview = new DataView(buffer);
L245:     dataview.setInt32(0, 3);
L246:     dataview.getInt32(1); // 768
L247:     `
L248:
